So, specifically when we learn and teach and discuss and whatever, be involved in in learning חסידות, and especially living and and, you know, doing חסידות in this way, that's what's going to bring משיח. So, a lot of times we like to sit back and think about, oh, you know, hope it's just going to happen passively or hope, you know, coronavirus is going to bring it. I mean, these things can be maybe triggers that can help activate it, but we have to do the עבודה. And so that's, you know, what really this is all about. And, yeah, הגאולה האמיתית והשלימה בקרוב ממש, and so all this should come with a complete and true redemption very soon. אמן. Amen. And and I guess would just add to this one note that like, you know, he was talking here about how this is going to reach also all people, also the the nations of the world that are not just the Jewish people, and in a way of being a מעיין, and I think this is, you know, the idea that it's not as long as we look at it as we have a message that we have and we have to also share it with them, that's not this real idea of הפצת מעיינות חוצה. That's bringing the water חוצה, it's not bringing the מעיין חוצה. Bringing the מעיין חוצה is that you see the potential in every person to be able to be a משפיע of this, to be able to be somebody that like it says, you know, that you learn from every person, like it says in פרקי אבות. So, you're not just seeing that you have something to teach everyone, but you see that you have something, that that there's this potential in that person to be brought out, that they can then be a source of teaching and spreading this and and living this and, you know, exemplifying it, and and something that that's to the world around them, and even to us, even, you know. So, that's a big big part of, I don't know what you want to call, maybe big part of משיח is this idea, like it talks about different מדרשים in the גמרא about how when משיח comes, every person will be like jealous from the, says from the חופה, the the canopy of his fellow, that you know we're going to each person's going to see the מעלה, advantage of another person and in their way of serving השם and and what they're able to accomplish, and as opposed to feeling that it's something that, you know, you know having the sense of elitism, it's the opposite of that, having the sense of humility and and, you know, learning from everybody as opposed to only just teaching everybody. So, that's, yeah, that's this idea of this קונטרס, and I think this will help us very much in understanding how to put together the יחודים as we get back, אם ירצה השם.
